instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. In a bright indoor hallway, the man in the brown cardigan (R1) kneels on the left, facing right. He places both hands gently on the shoulders of the boy in the white school shirt (R2), who stands on the right wearing a grey backpack. The man has a calm, supportive expression with closed eyes, while the boy looks down quietly. The background features a closed white door with a framed picture. Soft, cool daylight illuminates the scene from the side, casting gentle shadows and creating a tender, quiet atmosphere.
